text:
alex: Running into an intermittent hang with the Python SDK async streaming API. When the backend sends a final newline-only chunk and closes the socket, our async generator sometimes never completes and cancellation hangs.

alex: Minimal async repro:
```py
async with RedwoodClient(api_key=token) as client:
    agen = client.stream_response(model="mini-test")
    async for ev in agen:
        if ev.get("type") == "done":
            break
# occasionally never reaches here even after server FIN
```

alex: Env: python 3.11, redwood-py 0.9.3, aiohttp 3.9.2, nginx ingress. Happens more under bursty load.

jamie: Which HTTP transport? aiohttp or httpx? Any proxies/retries?

alex: aiohttp transport, no special retry.

sophia: This matches an SSE parser edge: we rely on an explicit empty-line to end an event. If the read returns b'' (EOF) before we see the empty-line, we never synthesize the final event.

carla: Do we forward generator.aclose() to the underlying reader to cancel reads? If not, we should expose a Stream object with cancel()/close() to make cancellation explicit.

alex: I called await agen.aclose() and it hung. task.cancel() also left socket refs stuck.

sophia: Quick fixes: (1) treat EOF (zero-length read) as equivalent to an empty-line event and emit the final event; (2) add a short safety read timeout at the transport layer. I'll implement (1) and add tests for: final chunk is "\n" then FIN, and final read is EOF with no newline.

jamie: Filed INF-4123 to track the CI flake and infra investigation.

deploy-bot: CI: test_stream_cancel flaky on linux-aio (FAILED)  retry queued for build/12844.

alex: Workaround: wrap iteration in asyncio.wait_for and call agen.aclose() in finally. Ugly but works.

sophia: I'll open a PR with the EOF-as-empty-line fix and unit tests; will also add a changelog note about aclose semantics.

carla: Also filed RDW-STREAMS-5 to propose a first-class Stream API for v1.0 that exposes cancel() for sync/async.

jamie: cc @devex for docs update once PR merged.

alex: Please ping when PR is ready; I'll validate against our ingress.
